Issue 1

⚔️ US-Iran Escalation and Attacks in the Gulf Region (Kuwait, Bahrain, Hormuz)

Key summary
  • Kuwait's military announced it intercepted a 'hostile' drone heading toward its airspace, and Bahrain also reported explosions near a US military base, officially condemning the strikes as a 'criminal attack' by Iran; Bahrain's defense authorities announced that its air defense network had intercepted multiple attacks originating from Iran.
  • US forces struck Iran's Qeshm Island, prompting Iran to carry out retaliatory attacks on US military radar facilities in Bahrain, while Kuwait and Bahrain each intercepted drone attacks, as the US-Iran conflict spread across the Gulf region.
  • The IRGC Navy claimed that a third 'illegally trespassing' tanker struck a mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz, though this remains independently unverified (reported solely by PressTV, requiring cross-verification).

Issue 2

🕊️ Gaza Ceasefire Implementation Crisis and Qatar's Mediation Role

Key summary
  • The US-led 'Board of Peace' delivered a pessimistic report to the UN Security Council on progress in Gaza's reconstruction, pointing to continued fighting and delays in implementing the 2025 ceasefire agreement, warning that without action the ceasefire is on the verge of collapse.
  • Israeli forces killed six Palestinians in Gaza and demolished homes, while West Bank settlers killed an elderly Palestinian woman and injured eight family members, as violence continued even during the ceasefire phase.
  • Israel also conducted psychological warfare by distributing leaflets with coffee and cigarettes to win over Gaza residents, while the US-led Board of Peace warned that the ceasefire is at risk of collapse due to delays in implementing the 2025 agreement and ongoing combat.

Issue 3

🇮🇱 Weakening of Netanyahu's Political Standing in Israel and Reshuffling of Knesset Power

Key summary
  • Israel's Knesset elected Matan Kahana, a member of Gadi Eisenkot's alliance, as the 26th Speaker of Parliament with the support of Arab parties, as the anti-Netanyahu camp seized key parliamentary positions.
  • Netanyahu's political base, having already lost its majority in last month's general election, is weakening further, and the 'election fraud' claims raised by Netanyahu's party have also been found to lack grounds.

Issue 4

⛽ Qatar LNG Supply Contract Termination (Orlen) and LNG Supply Chain Risk

Key summary
  • Poland's state-owned energy company Orlen has been confirmed to have canceled its Qatari LNG supply contract after months of a force majeure situation, illustrating a supply chain risk case related to the fulfillment of Qatar's LNG export contracts, with implications for the stability of Qatar's LNG exports to Europe.
  • The Korea-Middle East Cooperation Forum was held, discussing energy security and cooperation in new industries, while separately, a Saudi energy company was confirmed to be pursuing an investment of approximately $30 billion (about KRW 40 trillion) in constructing a natural gas pipeline in Pakistan.

This page automatically collects and summarizes public news coverage and material from relevant institutions across Qatar, Iran, other major countries and Korea. News is gathered by querying Google News RSS feeds, Naver News search, and outlet RSS (Al Jazeera, BBC, etc.) with keywords such as Qatar, the Middle East and energy; in-depth reports are collected directly from the publication boards and RSS of domestic and international research institutes, international organizations and consultancies (supplemented by news search targeting those publishers), keeping only analyses and reports on the Middle East situation, the Iran war and their industrial, supply-chain and energy repercussions. The report list accumulates items published since the war's outbreak (2026-02-28), split into domestic and overseas and ordered by publication date (newest first). Collection and summarization rely on each outlet's publicly available headline and snippet; for subscription or paywalled outlets, the full article can be opened through the provided source link only after the reader signs in or subscribes to that outlet directly. The collected articles are automatically clustered and summarized by issue, and translated into English and Arabic, by Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 5) AI. The whole process runs and publishes automatically twice a day (07:00 and 15:30 Qatar time) via GitHub Actions. The Qatar government activity section separately curates only official statements, announcements and actions on the war and regional situation by Qatar government and state entities — the Emir, the Prime Minister, the ministries of Foreign Affairs, Defense and Interior, the Government Communications Office (GCO), QatarEnergy and the state news agency (QNA). Owing to automated collection some articles or reports may be missed, so please re-verify important issues against the original sources and further searches.
- Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Qatar, Commercial Section · KOTRA Doha
